earnings.title: TechnipFMC Announces Third-Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Net income attributable to TechnipFMC was $418.4 million, or $1.05 per diluted share.
Cash flow from operations of $531 million; free cash flow of $470 million
outlook: Increased Subsea revenue guidance to a range of $9.6 - $9.8 billion for 2026
Anticipate Subsea inbound orders over the next five quarters to be at least $14.5 billion, when including expectations for 2027

items.heading: Demand for our products and services depends on oil and natural gas industry activity and expenditure levels, which are directly affected by trends in the demand for and price of oil and natural gas.
